As that initial brightness settles, body relaxation becomes more prominent, creating a mellow, easygoing feel. Beneath the sweetness, a faint fuel-like aroma adds depth alongside subtle earthy undertones. The flavor develops from juicy fruit into a fuller, creamy finish, leaving a lingering candy sweetness with a touch of spice. Its blend of fruit, cream, and gas gives the profile a distinctive Runtz character.
